subject.title: feat(ios): unify chat and voice experience

question: Should the iOS app permanently replace the standalone Talk destination with Chat-owned realtime voice while retaining the shipped talk and voice launch aliases as redirects?
rationale: This changes a shipped navigation and voice workflow rather than merely fixing established behavior, and the canonical linked issue is explicitly waiting for product direction.

options.title: Adopt unified Chat
options.body: Remove the Talk tab, retain compatible launch redirects, and land after localization cleanup and exact-head validation.

options.title: Keep separate Talk
options.body: Preserve the standalone Talk destination and narrow this work to session-ownership and Live Activity safety improvements.

options.title: Stage the redesign
options.body: Keep the existing default while evaluating unified Chat in an internal or beta-only product experiment.

recommendation.title: Adopt unified Chat
recommendation.body: Remove the Talk tab, retain compatible launch redirects, and land after localization cleanup and exact-head validation.

likelyOwner.reason: The repository’s contributor guidance most directly associates this person with the iOS application and its product surface.
